subject: Hosting
author: Jinno Angelo
body:
I just wanted to thank Zombie for doing an excellent job on hosting the 2nd room. Good One and much props to you. The tournament results are posted on the xbox forums. I placed them there already and I am looking for suggestions on expanding the tournaments because I know more people would like to get into it.  So far both tournaments went well. Some majors issues were encountered today but its not about the setup, more about having lag in the game. I would like your thoughts on that tho. I posted this on the xbox forums with a little bit more indepth look at the situation. Otherwise everyone likes the format, the set up is great, and everyone races well. 

These are extremely fast rooms, I know. I was kind of astounded myself earlier today too about my lap times. I guess I have a new one, but a legit one without glitches on WMF. We ran it earlier twice and both times, I ended up getting 1.43.43 and 1.43.33 without glenning and without hitting the glitches. It seems I get faster everytime I race or get back into burnout after a while of not playing it. I didnt do well overall tho, and so did many poeple. But, I do know that we could race better than how we performed tonight. I know because many of us havent been touching Revenge that much lately before this 2nd tournament and now with the 3rd tournament coming up soon, we will be devoting some time into it again... 

One more thing, competition will always be high in my rooms and in any tournaments I host..  

 

Don't wake me cause I'm dreaming, of Angels on the moon. Iam Nero Angelo!
